purpose: Test whether a native-state downstream margin derivative generates the construction-dependent absolute causal amplitude of grouped MLP6--7 without using target intervention outcomes as predictor inputs.
data_status: RETROSPECTIVE_FROZEN_CAUSAL_TARGETS; midpoint/base downstream gradients are new and predictions are frozen before computing them; diagnostic before any prospective promotion

binding_evidence.finding: Valid causal target: normalized shape transfers but FIT absolute baseline/amplitude fails on pristine HOLDOUT.
Frozen 40-row FIT/HOLDOUT authority with native capability 100% in all 18 cells.

novelty_audit: Authority searches for MLP6-7 margin JVP, downstream gradient, midpoint task gradient, amplitude generator, and native-state amplitude found no prior event.

Prior midpoint work differentiates grouped-source transport only to the L11H3 head vector. This test differentiates the native downstream answer margin with respect to that head interface, which is a distinct missing map.
map: For each row and E/A/U/W endpoint background, generate base and exact grouped-X L11H3 head vectors from native weights. At h_base and h_mid=(h_base+h_exact)/2, differentiate the final signed answer margin through the unchanged native tail. Predict the unseen causal amplitude as grad_h margin dot (h_exact-h_base). Compare with the already-frozen exact-minus-base causal q only after predictions are computed. No causal target q, fitted coefficient, or target endpoint scale enters the predictor.

predictions.pred_a_gradient_instrument: All source and downstream decomposition closures are at most 5e-5, both replacement tensors receive finite nonzero gradients, and exactly 80 row/background amplitudes are predicted at each linearization point.
predictions.pred_b_midpoint_generates_amplitude: Across all 80 amplitudes, midpoint prediction has cosine at least 0.90, relative L2 error at most 0.30, and sign agreement at least 0.90.
predictions.pred_c_midpoint_generalizes_by_phase: FIT and HOLDOUT separately each have cosine at least 0.85, relative L2 error at most 0.35, and sign agreement at least 0.875.
predictions.pred_d_both_backgrounds_are_predictable: Empty and EAUW backgrounds separately each have cosine at least 0.85 and relative L2 error at most 0.35.
predictions.pred_e_midpoint_improves_endpoint: Midpoint relative L2 error is at least 20% lower than base-endpoint-gradient relative L2 error.
predictions.pred_f_holdout_amplitude_beats_fit_mean: On HOLDOUT, midpoint JVP reduces squared error at least 30% versus assigning each row the FIT mean exact q for its direction/background.

null: Failure of b-d means one downstream tangent is not an amplitude generator and the target-endpoint dependency remains. Failure of e means the native endpoint derivative is sufficient and midpoint computation is unnecessary. Failure of f means a direction/background lookup explains any apparent success. Preserve the diagnostic level; only a pass merits prospective testing on new causal outcomes.
